question.text: Training expectations for Cat III AIF distributors are best described as:

answer.text: Proper training, thorough product/industry understanding, and staying updated with market and fund developments

explanation.text: The Logic: Cat III AIF distribution requires proper training and a thorough understanding of the industry and products, and distributors should stay updated with market and fund developments (pp. 4, 7-8, 82, 340, 345). The Trap: Treating training as optional, one-time, or only for new distributors falls short of these expectations. Note: Certification expiry and fresh certification at p. 93 applies to key investment team personnel of the manager, not to distributors as a renewal requirement.
